name: Enchanter
summary: A Universal World Class any character may take regardless of their class. An enchanter lays magic on top of an item the smith or the leatherworker made: a circle of chalk and ink, essences seated where they fit, and a binding timed to the light. Enchanter level stands in for caster level; essences are the cost.
_ruling_2026_10_05_note: The owner's enchanting revamp (docs/enchanting-answers.md rounds 1-7, docs/enchanting-revamp-plan.md §4, §5, §10), 'same as the others'. Three unlock levels replace five: level 1 the whole ritual in miniature (prepare, attune, bind, read, identify, unbind) on common and uncommon essence; level 2 refine, rare and exotic essence, and more than one new property in one working; level 3 cleanse and legendary essence. Then endless levels with perks (potency, quality, yield, capacity). Scribe, focus, channel, seal, imbue, empower and awaken are gone, with the `legendary-binding` milestone and its deed (old recipes map through `old_methods`). Old Enchanter 4 and 5 keep their level, which now is their bank of perk picks, as the Herbalist's and the Blacksmith's did.
_thresholds_note: Mastery to reach levels 2 and 3; every level after that is priced by `endless`. 25 and 65 are the Herbalist's and the Blacksmith's numbers on purpose: the crafts pace the same.
_endless_note: Levels past the written table (plan §5.2, the owner's 'use the proposed numbers', round 4 point 9). Leaving level 3 costs `base` and each level after it `step` more. Each endless level banks `picks_per_level` picks; the same perk may be taken twice. `perks` is what one pick is worth: potency adds that fraction to the house top-ups of everything you bind (book numbers never scale); quality raises the ceiling one step; yield is the chance per binding that one essence is not consumed (the engine rolls it and shows the roll); capacity is +1 to what an item you bind holds, with no ceiling (owner, round 4 point 1).
_ceiling_note: `ceiling` is the highest quality index a level's hands can reach (0 Crude, 1 Sound, 2 Fine, 3 Superior, 4 Flawless), plan §10.2. A binding's quality is also held under the circle it was laid in: Prepare's and Attune's quality + 1 (the bench block's `circle_lift`).

levels.note: The whole ritual in miniature: lay a circle round the item, seat the essences where they fit, bind them at the crest. One new property in a working. Common and uncommon essence; Fine work at best.
Refine (condense essences of one family into one fuller phial), more than one new property in one working, and rare and exotic essence. Superior work.
Cleanse (lift a known curse and keep the rest of the layer) and legendary essence. Flawless work.

method_descriptions.prepare: Lays the circle round a vessel and cuts its sigils: chalk or salt for the ring, ink for the signs, a focus set into a ring or amulet, a treatment if you have one. The vessel comes off the floor prepared.
method_descriptions.attune: Seats essences on a prepared vessel, one to each seat whose sign it answers. Choices are made here (bane's foe, a resistance's energy). An attuned vessel holds for a day; after that the essences drift back to the shelf unharmed.
method_descriptions.bind: The book's creation check on an attuned vessel: DC 5 + the item's caster level, +5 for each prerequisite you lack. Success puts the work into In progress for the book's time; a miss by 1 to 4 does not take and keeps the essences; a miss by 5 or more takes, flawed, with a hidden curse.
method_descriptions.refine: Condenses two or more phials of one essence family into one fuller phial, so a seat holds more motes. Each draw is paler than the last: a careless refine loses motes.
method_descriptions.unbind: Unpicks a magic item's layer, last sigil first. The smith's item stays; a quarter of the layer's motes come back as residue, and you learn what kind of magic it carried.
method_descriptions.cleanse: Lifts a curse you know of, sigil by sigil, and keeps the rest of the layer. DC 10 + the item's caster level, the book's remove curse.
method_descriptions.read: Tastes a pinch of an essence (a tenth of a phial) to learn one thing about it.
method_descriptions.identify: Studies an item for what it was made to do. Beat the DC by 10 to see a curse as well. Once per item per day.

_method_help_note: One entry per method, and the set must match method_descriptions exactly (tests/test_enchanter.py). `does` is the mechanical effect in numbers, `needs` what must be in the circle, `for` what a player reaches for it to do.

prepare.does: DC 5 + 5 for each rarity band of the rarest circle material. Spends the chalk or salt, the ink and any treatment; sets a ring or amulet's focus. The binding later can reach one quality step above the circle's.
prepare.needs: A vessel from your pack (a Superior or better weapon, armour or shield, or a ring, amulet or wondrous blank), one chalk or salt, one ink.
prepare.for: Starting any enchantment. A good circle is what lets a binding reach Superior and Flawless.

attune.does: DC 5 + 5 for each rarity band of the rarest essence seated. Nothing is spent: the essences sit in the vessel for a day. Each seated essence whose family suits a material in the vessel is -1 DC at Bind (at most -2).
attune.needs: A prepared vessel and an essence for each new property, plus enough motes between them to pay for the working.
attune.for: Choosing what the item will carry and paying for it in motes.

bind.does: DC 5 + the item's caster level, +5 per spell you neither know nor carry, +5 if your Enchanter level is below the caster level it asks, +5 to hurry. A catalyst lowers it. Then the work waits In progress: 8 hours per 1,000 gp, as working days on the calendar.
bind.for: Making the enchantment. Its essence family's time of day widens the binding's windows; Wait for it moves the clock there.

refine.does: DC 5 + 5 for each rarity band of the essence. Two or more phials of one family become one, its motes the sum times how cleanly you drew (Crude loses a fifth, Flawless nothing).
refine.needs: Enchanter 2, a sanctum, and two or more phials of one essence family.
refine.for: Fitting a costly working into the vessel's few seats.

unbind.does: DC 10 + the item's caster level. The layer comes off whole, curse and all; a quarter of its motes come back as arcane residue; you learn the kinds of property it carried, never their size.
unbind.needs: A magic item from your pack.
unbind.for: Learning what found magic does, recovering a cursed item, or starting a vessel over.

cleanse.does: DC 10 + the item's caster level. The curse is lifted; the rest of the layer stays.
cleanse.needs: Enchanter 3, a sanctum, and an item whose curse you know.
cleanse.for: Keeping a flawed binding's magic without its curse.

read.does: 10 minutes and a tenth of a phial: one trait of the essence. A volatile essence bites the one who reads it.
read.for: Finding out what an essence will do before you bind it.

identify.does: DC 15 + the item's caster level, the better of your Enchanter check and your Spellcraft. Beat it to learn what the item was made to do; beat it by 10 to see a curse too.
identify.for: Knowing what you carry, and whether it is cursed.

_bench_note: The circle's rule rows (docs/enchanting-revamp-plan.md §6, §10, §14), read by rules/enchanter.py. Every number the plan marks proposed lives here so it tunes without a code change. `where`: `quiet` is anywhere out of a fight; `sanctum` needs one (a founded place of kind sanctum you hold, rules/places.py tags). `minutes` is the ritual's own time; a binding's countdown is the book's working days (8 hours of work to a calendar day, plan §6.8). Tuning is for the minigames: `seconds`, the base `difficulty`, and the band the strip draws; `phase_widen` (1.5, owner round 4 point 9) widens Bind's windows inside the essence family's phase of the day, `eager_widen` the eager trait's 10%.

prepare.name: Prepare
prepare.takes: a vessel, chalk or salt, ink, and a focus for a ring or amulet

bind.name: Bind
bind.takes: an attuned vessel, and a catalyst if you have one

refine.name: Refine
refine.takes: two or more phials of one essence family

unbind.name: Unbind
unbind.makes: the item without its layer, residue and knowledge

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.takes: an item whose curse you know

bench._seats_note: The seats a vessel offers Attune, by what the book prices it as (rules/magic_layer.vessel_kind), each named for the piece it sits on (UI plan §6.5: a blade's point, edge and guard). `piece` is the record's piece the seat answers for an affinity; a seat with none answers only the vessel's polarity. The number of seats is how many phials one working can take.
bench._polarity_note: Which essence polarities a vessel takes (materials.POLARITIES). An essence of another polarity is refused at Attune with the reason: an arcane essence is a weapon's +N priced at a weapon's rate, and on armour it would be the wrong price. `any` goes anywhere.
bench._numbers_note: The owner's round 4 point 9 numbers: affinity -1 DC a matching seat, at most -2; Bind's windows x1.5 inside the family's phase; residue a quarter of the layer's motes; attuned vessels hold a day (1440 minutes); a binding's quality at most the circle's + 1 (plan §10.2, proposed). `step_dc` is the herb and forge benches' intermediate-step DC, 5 + 5 per rarity band (crafting `base_dc`). `refine_yield` is the fraction of motes kept at each quality index (Crude 0.8 ... Flawless 1.0, proposed; Cennini's 'each draw is paler').

_old_methods_note: Methods removed 2026-10-05 and what an old recipe naming one maps onto (plan §19). Read by the migration (lane H); `imbue` became a level 2 permission, not a method; `empower` and `awaken` are dropped with a note.
_fixed_tools_note: Read now, as the forge's are. A sanctum is a place you found and own (rules/places.py, kind `sanctum`); Refine, Cleanse and legendary essence need one (plan §14).
